params.requirement: Writes one sentence per changed fact over a night of memory, naming both values and the date. It needs precise, faithful summarising of structured input and exact adherence to the output form. It runs once a night and never while anybody waits, so it may be slow, and quality comes first.

model.description: MODEL_DREAMER — REQUIRED, no default: a model default in code is how a run silently measures a different model than the report claims (P5 finding)

thinking_budget.description: The deliberation budget of this cell in tokens, a literal of its own `params` (KD diagnosis 2026-10-06, R-HK-15): sent as `reasoning.max_tokens`, so the provider cannot map an effort to whatever it likes; the night writes one sentence per changed fact and needs little deliberation. Until memory-hive 3.9.0 the knob was `provider_extra.reasoning.effort` "medium". A registry push resets it to this value; no model package carries it.

description.purpose: Writes the narrative belief over one delta window: per (subject, predicate) axis one sentence that names the change — both values and the date. Since P15/R9 it no longer judges supersession: which fact wins is arithmetic (dream-glue derives it from the chain), and arithmetic needs no opinion. The expensive model tier — it runs once a night, never per turn.
description.use_when: Called by dream-glue once per consolidation run with the scoped clusters.
description.not_in_scope: No store access, no application of its own verdicts (dream-glue applies them, logged and reversible), no extraction, and since R9 no supersession verdict at all — the request shape has no `supersede` slot any more.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one assistant turn holding the verdict JSON (beliefs / retract). hop.finish_reason='error' closes the run cleanly with an error verdict instead of leaving it 'running'.
description.consumes_meaning: system.instructions.text: the belief contract, handed over by dream-glue's scope phase (an llm cell has no params.system — the prompt travels in the message, which is why it lives in dream-glue). messages[]: the window's facts grouped by subject, oldest first, each with valid_from/valid_until. The one body without messages[] is a params-only push on the hive's `in_model` door (GH #858): an empty system slot and a params slot the cell merges into its live params, answered with nothing.
examples: two diet facts on one axis -> {"beliefs":[{"holder":"self","statement":"Alex drank tea until 2026-05, then switched","source_fact_ids":["f1","f2"]}]}
